# Test data

Examples from the gridyard local API contract, version `api` 1 (planning repository, commit `f59e62d`,
`homeassistant/lokale-api/`), unchanged. Values are synthetic.

| File | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `proto-ver.local.response.json` | `proto-ver` of the local API |
| `device-info.response.json` | `device-info` |
| `profiles.response.json` | `profiles`, first page |
| `state.response.json` | `state` |
| `error.response.json` | error format of the JSON endpoints |
